name: Del Piero
source:
A childhood friend of Lung's since elementary school.
When threatened by Ding Xiu to investigate the background of Francis' attacker, he succeeds in calling Lung out with a convincing performance.
After Lung's escape, Lung asked him to keep an unobtrusive eye on Yen, but he was once mistakenly accused of stalking her and ended up in trouble with the police.
When Yen disappeared for the second time, Lai and Yvet interviewed him.
